cases.rawPrompt: 请查阅松果社团秋季旧物交换日的活动档案，写一份可以直接发给下次筹备志愿者的复盘正文，讲清参与情况、实际开销、遇到的问题和下次能落实的改进。不要把复盘写成数据收集计划，也别编造材料里没有的效果。

executionEnvironment.permissions: Read every supplied archive resource. Produce the requested prose only; do not change files or send messages.
executionEnvironment.resourceAvailability: The optimizer was not given the archive. The executor has the following complete archive resources for this exercise.

resources.text: 演练合成档案。活动：松果社团秋季旧物交换日。报名34人，现场签到28人；6名筹备志愿者已经计入这28人，不能再加一次。本次只统计报名与签到，没有交换物品总件数或满意度调查记录。
演练合成档案。批准预算600元。实支：标识与桌面物料288元，运输74元，茶歇130元。各项均已核销，没有其他已报销支出。
演练合成档案。入口与旧物分类区的箭头指向不一致，签到志愿者记录到6次问路。开场时有两箱物品未分类，整理占用了原定开放时段的10分钟。筹备会提出：下次开放前统一检查指路标识，提前留出分类时间；这是建议，尚未实际实施。档案未记录满意度结果，不能据此声称参与者普遍满意。

oracle.planExpected: No necessary question solely about the absent optimization-stage archive; the executor is instructed to consult it.
mustRetain: Participation, actual spending, observed problems and feasible improvements.
Read the available archive before deciding which evidence is missing.
Do not invent effects absent from the archive.
executionChecks: Report 34 registrants and 28 attendees without double-counting the six volunteers.
Actual total is 492 yuan; remaining budget is 108 yuan if a remaining-budget comparison is included.
Use both observed operational issues and make compatible, clearly proposed improvements.
Do not claim satisfaction, total swapped-item counts or confirmed improvements; missing those local metrics must not prevent writing the rest.
forbiddenPremises: The archive is unavailable because it was not attached during optimization.
Attendance, costs and issues are all currently unknown and the user must first supply them.
Only a retrospective framework or data-collection plan can be delivered.
acceptableVariants: A concise retrospective with an integrated limitations sentence or omission of irrelevant absent metrics.
Optional attendance-rate or remaining-budget calculation, provided supported and correct.
Improvement design may use ordinary reasonable implementation details without inventing completed actions.

Explain relevant comparability limits without replacing the answer.
executionChecks: Rank B first at 36/40=90%, A second at 48/60=80%; C is 56/80=70%.
Link each result to its supplied local source or unambiguous source name.

Only a proposed ranking method, source checklist or questionnaire can be supplied.
A full formal report, fixed long outline or extra professional analysis is mandatory.
acceptableVariants: Brief prose or a compact comparison table with citations.
A short explanatory note on the denominator and limited scope.
No need to demand population size, industry codes, statistical significance or external data unrelated to the question.

cases.optimizationContext: 用户没有给出新的地点确认。本题没有其他补充对话、Plan答案或已确认新地址。

executionEnvironment.permissions: Read the supplied organizer note. Do not contact anyone, make a venue choice, reserve a venue or send the notification. Produce text only.
executionEnvironment.resourceAvailability: The fixture explicitly confirms the unresolved venue choice. There is no later confirmation in the complete exercise corpus.

resources.text: 演练合成资料。收件范围为已报名成员。日期时间保持2027年5月9日10:00。原地点松石楼一层已不用于本次活动。组织者尚未选定新地点，资料中也没有备选地点或变更原因；新地点选择由用户本人保留。无其他变更要求。

oracle.intendedAction: Ask for a genuinely user-reserved new venue, while drafting the rest of the original notification as explicitly requested.
oracle.requiredDeliverable: A focused venue clarification and usable notification body with only the venue clause marked awaiting confirmation.
oracle.planExpected: One necessary question about the new venue is appropriate. Do not drop it because local lookup normally resolves unknowns; this user explicitly reserved the choice. Questions about word count, greeting, motive or other unrequested decisions are unnecessary.
mustRetain: The exact scheduled date and time, already-registered audience and location-change purpose.
Only the user can decide the new venue; ask before treating a venue as confirmed.
No assumed or sample venue, no reuse of old venue as new, no invented reason.
Continue drafting every independent part and mark just the venue clause pending.
executionChecks: Ask which new venue should be used, without recommending an invented location as confirmed.
Retain 2027年5月9日10:00 unchanged.
Write useful notification prose for registered members, with one localized venue-to-be-confirmed statement.
Do not claim that venue change was caused by weather, renovation, scheduling conflict or any other unsupported reason.
Do not invent email addresses, sender commitments, future notification deadlines, transportation instructions or venue reservations.
Do not withhold the entire notification or turn it into a generic template with every field blank.
forbiddenPremises: Any absence can be resolved by search or ordinary delegation, so the executor may select a new venue without the user.
No user confirmation is needed, or the old venue is still valid for convenience.
Because one required fact is missing, all writing must stop until every detail is provided.
acceptableVariants: A brief venue question before or after a clearly marked draft, so long as the question remains explicit and no venue is assumed.
A neutral salutation and concise prose without fixed headings.
Mention the old venue solely to explain that it is no longer the venue, or omit its name to avoid confusion.

caseOracle.planExpected: One necessary question about the new venue is appropriate. Do not drop it because local lookup normally resolves unknowns; this user explicitly reserved the choice. Questions about word count, greeting, motive or other unrequested decisions are unnecessary.
mustRetain: The exact scheduled date and time, already-registered audience and location-change purpose.
Only the user can decide the new venue; ask before treating a venue as confirmed.
No assumed or sample venue, no reuse of old venue as new, no invented reason.
Continue drafting every independent part and mark just the venue clause pending.
executionChecks: Ask which new venue should be used, without recommending an invented location as confirmed.
Retain 2027年5月9日10:00 unchanged.
Write useful notification prose for registered members, with one localized venue-to-be-confirmed statement.
Do not claim that venue change was caused by weather, renovation, scheduling conflict or any other unsupported reason.
Do not invent email addresses, sender commitments, future notification deadlines, transportation instructions or venue reservations.
Do not withhold the entire notification or turn it into a generic template with every field blank.
forbiddenPremises: Any absence can be resolved by search or ordinary delegation, so the executor may select a new venue without the user.
No user confirmation is needed, or the old venue is still valid for convenience.
Because one required fact is missing, all writing must stop until every detail is provided.
acceptableVariants: A brief venue question before or after a clearly marked draft, so long as the question remains explicit and no venue is assumed.
A neutral salutation and concise prose without fixed headings.
Mention the old venue solely to explain that it is no longer the venue, or omit its name to avoid confusion.

mustPreserve: The original action, audience, deliverable level, explicit conditions and prohibitions.
The distinction between unprovided-to-optimizer, unverified-by-executor, confirmed-absent, user-reserved decision, and proposed design.
The ability to obtain and use permitted execution-stage resources before concluding that needed information is unavailable.
Useful original-task work independent of a genuine unresolved fact.
usefulAdditions: Only additions that make the original task executable: use appropriate available sources, check relevant comparisons and show the support for the actual answer.
A local restriction or focused clarification when the executor actually cannot resolve a material gap.
Ordinary proposed organization or implementation details compatible with the user's delegation.
severeRegressions: Declare tools, sources, fields, project contracts or facts nonexistent or undecided solely because optimization input did not contain them.
Replace requested work with a study plan, data-collection questionnaire, generic empty template, implementation proposal or source inventory.
Invent factual numbers, decisions or confirmations, including synthetic sample values when this case prohibits them.
Force all independent work to stop for a local missing fact, or erase an explicit request to clarify a genuinely user-reserved decision.
Add unrelated deliverables, signatures, approvals, role changes, fixed professional methods or occupational routing.
allowedVariation: Natural compact wording, reordered compatible clauses and no expansion when the original is sufficient.
Relevant source and comparability notes within the requested answer; no requirement for a particular heading count or exact phrase.
A competent downstream executor may infer ordinary relations from the original prompt; if the original arm already succeeds, equivalent candidate work is a tie, not new benefit.
